thread:
noah: Cutting release now but deploy-bot failed artifact verify on canary. Holding cut. :warning:

deploy-bot: VERIFY FAILED for redwood/edge-proxy:2026-03-23-canary
  failure: part-002 checksum mismatch (expected f4b2..., got 0000...)
  action: halt promotion

emma: that 0000... usually means a zero-byte multipart part. Any signs of CI restore storms?

ci-bot: CI build 3910 summary:
- cache restore: parallel restores triggered at 13:10 UTC
- artifact upload: multipart put part-002 returned 200 but size=0 on subsequent head-object
- finalize: complete-multipart returned 200, but GET shows empty part

devon: options: reupload & re-sign (10-15m), pin to last-good canary and promote now, or wait for infra investigation. Change window is ~25m.

noah: prefer pin to last-good to avoid user impact. We'll schedule a rebuild with single-part fallback after infra clears.

emma: agreed. pinning now to redwood/edge-proxy:2026-03-22-canary-stable

deploy-bot: Pin applied. Promoting pinned image to prod tags: prod/2026-03-23-rc. Rolling traffic over 2m. Smoke checks running.

ci-bot: original artifact retained at buildkite-agent/3910 for later reupload attempt.

infra-bot: Alert INFRA-S3-PARTIAL: 12 partial commit events in last 2h. Investigating S3 client's multipart finalize path and network retries.

devon: action items:
- infra: deep-dive S3 partial commit (ticket INFRA-839)
- build: single-part upload fallback and zero-byte-part retry logic (PR queued)
- release: note in release notes: "Production promoted using previously validated canary due to transient artifact verification; follow-up rebuild planned."

noah: smoke green. Proceeding with release tracking. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
